F-03 WOTS leaf reuse across reloads/devices
gates.detail: Program change: open_session (creator-only) burns the leaf on chain before any proof byte is revealed and never releases it; chunk 0 and withdraw must match the reserved leaf. A rolled-back journal or second device can no longer publish a second signature for a leaf. Compiled-SBF tested locally; on the registered Devnet program leaf 2 was reserved at open_session and is consumed in the live bitmap after the E8 withdrawal (Devnet behaviour only; Mainnet bytes not built with a real id, not independently audited). Residual: a compromised creator wallet can burn leaves (liveness, not custody).
